{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Fox statues by the thousand, and the gates go up until your legs ask politely to stop."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The wooden stage hangs over the hillside like a dare, and the view of the city is the reward."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A canal-side stroll where the cherry blossoms lean in to read over your shoulder."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The silver pavilion keeps its shine quiet, and the sand garden looks raked by a very patient ghost."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Graze the market lanes for yuba and pickles; the tofu doughnuts vanish fast."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk the old geisha street slowly; the wooden facades do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A quiet tofu set dinner that even the most devoted carnivore would not argue with."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Slip down the lantern-lit alley after dark and let the river breeze choose the bar."}]}
Shoes off, phone down, eyes up — market bites, temple gold, bamboo breeze, and every must-do tucked in before the flight.
